outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: red_reading now times the one stamp-verification red run (UTC start + monotonic ms) and leaves a proof stage on ctx[PROOF_STAGE] (also for refused / blockless runs); its basis names each leg's seconds as the helper reported them (proof_legs_said), a leg not run with the helper's why, or 'not reported' when no payload/legs. Writer path: writer_prove drops any stale stage, prove_and_hold calls queue_proof_stage (queue_stage source proof:<start>, write_state) before the refusal branch. submit: note_proof_stage notes the stage through audit-task.py note --stage (locked write; submit holds no drive-state lock, which wave members share) right after red_block, before the stop check, basis suffixed that on the Agent route it lies inside the writer's hand-out-to-filing length. stage_args refactored onto stage_words. stamp-verification.py: red payload gains legs (red_legs: baseline/task/fix always listed, ran:false+why+seconds:null when not made; task-held/task-support/second only when made) and run.seconds (the task run's). tests: pq0-pq7 in test_drive_phase.py (_proof_stage_units, in ux-block), sr4l/sr4n in test_stamp_verification.py (_leg_cases, in sr-red); the retired-return case fp2* now allows the one proof-timing note and asserts the real note --stage put one proof stage on the task's timing. Docs: two paragraphs in PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (drive-phase and stamp-verification sections), changelog.d/P173.2.changed.md. Gate: sweep-selftests over both files exit 0 (2/2 files ok, 1489 cases); register-citations 0 found; release.py changelog-check ok. Dependants: red_reading parse - still correct, the triple it returns is unchanged and the stage rides ctx; hold_proof - unchanged, still given block/payload; note_reproof - unchanged, its note still carries no stages (the proof stage was queued by prove_and_hold before it and rides the next session note or close); test_drive_phase/test_stamp_verification dependants (test_drive_without_model, test__filed_returns, tools/affected.py) import names I did not rename or remove. Overlap caveat: on the Agent route the submit's proof stage is inside the writer stage (hand-out to filing), so summarize reports it as overrun there; the basis says so. Note: I wrote the stamp-verification.py edit and the tests edit through a python heredoc via Bash before switching to Edit for drive-phase.py (the plan gate refused that heredoc for drive-phase.py at magnitude over its limit; the stamp-verification.py one, smaller, was not refused).
